I am receiving avatar Moderation Report Closed notifications since this week, but those notifications don't immediately seem to have a correlated report in Closed Reports. (However, the Closed Reports section lists sorts by original report submission date, not by report closed date, as far as I'm aware.)

```

2026.02.19 00:31:29 Debug      -  Received Notification: <Notification from username:, sender user id: to usr_6fa4abc5-9952-4a0a-97de-b3598fbf6a5c of type: moderation, id: not_86055773-e1b5-4362-af10-5b312e7d2876, created at: 02/18/2026 14:XX:XX UTC, details: {{}}, type:moderation, m seen:False, message: "The avatar associated with a report you submitted was actioned by the moderation team. This may be as a result of a report you submitted or from the report of another user. Thank you for helping to keep VRChat safe!">

```

Usually these [Moderation Report Closed notifications would be duplicated](https://feedback.vrchat.com/bug-reports/p/moderation-report-closed-notifications-are-duplicated), but unusually none have been duplicated this week.

Anecdotally I've seen this affect group reports too, but there is no Closed Report for a group (and the logs/notifications for this have already been wiped).

I'm unable to reproduce. 4 unique notifications, 4 closed reports.

details:
Noticed that issue since couple days. Before, when an avatar got moderated, it was notified on website and ingame ; and we can see what got moderated by being ingame, opening the little option menu, select the exclamation mark bubble, view reports, and closed reports category.

Right now, user and group moderation appears, but not the avatars ones anymore. It says like usual on website that they got moderated, but no notifications ingame, and the closed avatar reports don't appear anymore in the closed reports section ingame. Don't know if this is intended or not, but just wanted let you know in case of.
title: Notifications about avatars moderated don't appear anymore
